items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: We did a tour of the east coast, of all the big coliseums, and on the bus was the Dave Brubeck Quartet, Sonny Rollins Trio, the Four Freshmen and the Maynard Ferguson band, and all the producers.

ctx.x: There’s a picture there. We did a tour of the east coast, of all the big coliseums, and on the bus was the Dave Brubeck Quartet, Sonny Rollins Trio, the Four Freshmen and the Maynard Ferguson band, and all the producers. And in the middle of the tour we had a day off. And somehow I caught my finger in the car door and the pictures there, somebody took a picture of me with that. And somehow, I think it was this one, I played. Everybody was helping me lift things up in the back of the bus and so on. I finished the…
What was it like to be living on a musician’s income at that time? Was it okay?
